name: Shakhty-Volgodonsk Gas Pipeline
monitor_reason: length: trunk length is not sourced anywhere found (no km figure for the existing Shakhty-Volgodonsk main line). Only sourced length is 50.5 km for a separate DN500 bypass (gazoprovod-peremychka k GRS Volgodonsk-1, built 2023 by Gazstroyproekt) whose owner and exact endpoints are not stated on the contractor page; it is a repair bypass, not clearly this line. Staged values are provisional context only, not a row.
researcher_notes: No roster match: P2381/P5665 Rostov-Maykop and P1471 Novopskov-Aksai-Mozdok are different lines. CONFIRMED: (1) existing Shakhty-Volgodonsk main gas line is Volgodonsk's main gas source (Bloknot-Volgodonsk 2015-10-01; Gazprom subsidiary Gazprom Centrremont won the PSD tender, >500m RUB; three build options incl. parallel line; works planned 2016-17, schedule at risk). (2) Federal territorial plan (Govt order 816-r, Annex 4 item 101, ed. 17.12.2025) lists 'expansion of gas transport capacity ... on section Shakhty-Volgodonsk', design average annual volume 3.32 bcm/y, across Volgodonskoy, Zimovniki, Dubovsky, Oktyabrsky, Ust-Donetsky, Konstantinovsky, Tsimlyansky districts; no length given, no named owner, no concrete construction step on file. (3) Gazstroyproekt page: DN500, 7.4/5.4 MPa, 50.5 km bypass to GRS Volgodonsk-1 on the Shakhty-Volgodonsk section completed Oct 2023 (built in preparation for repair of the main line). FAILED legs: (d) length unsourced for the trunk; (a) owner unsourced in a fetched page (presumably Gazprom group, not asserted). Next step if pursued: find Gazprom transgaz (Krasnodar/Volgograd) source giving trunk km and diameter, or decide whether the 50.5 km bypass is its own row. Unreachable: volgodonskgorod.ru (no response) and volgodonsk.pro (522). Tier medium.
